editorial:
Imagine living in a quiet retirement home where everything seems peaceful, but something scary is lurking in the woods nearby. You follow a blind army veteran who moves into this community and quickly realizes that his neighbors are acting very strange. While the other seniors seem terrified and secretive, you get to see the world through the eyes of a man who uses his other senses to survive. The vibe is tense and creepy, making you feel like you are trapped in a puzzle where you do not have all the pieces.

What really makes this work is how the movie handles the action and the suspense. The acting is solid, and the way it builds up to the big reveal keeps you glued to your seat. Some parts might feel a bit slow at first, but the payoff is totally worth it. If you enjoy thrillers with a twist, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: You find out the monsters are actually creatures that the retirement home staff were keeping and feeding. The twist is that the seniors were being used as food to keep the beasts happy. In the final fight, the blind veteran uses his combat skills and knowledge of the layout to kill the monsters. He manages to survive the bloodbath and escape the facility, finally putting an end to the secret horror happening in the woods.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves monster movies and surprising plot twists.
